# Pleasant Valley Collection Tickets: Best Pre-War Money Method

![Pleasant Valley Collection Tickets: Best Pre-War Money Method](/uploads/745_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Pleasant Valley Pickup Tickets** are a rare reward from **Ghouls** and **Burned Ones**. The drop chance from loot from these enemies is **2%**.

Prerequisite: Quest "**Key to the Past**" has been completed.

(Raider Ques series, see Wiki)

You automatically accumulate Pleasant Valley pickup tickets over time. Every time you loot ghouls or burnt ones, the collection tickets can be there. Even if the chance is only 2%, due to the mass of ghouls and burned people in the world and in events, a lot can add up quickly. In addition, the pickup tickets can also be sold to other players as they are **tradable**.

### Where can Pleasant Valley pickup tickets be redeemed?

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-pleasant-valley-tickets-01-cropped-map.jpg)

At the Pleasant Valley Ski Resort you can redeem your Pleasant Valley pickup tickets at the Protectron Bot “Bellhop” in the basement. You can only open the basement room with an access card that you had in the "Key to the Past" quest.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-pleasant-valley-tickets-02.jpg)

## Pleasant Valley Pickup Tickets Rewards

To redeem the pickup tickets, simply press “Interact” at Bellhop. The bot will then check your ticket and roll out your reward.

You will receive **10-55 pre-war money** per Pleasant Valley pickup ticket, which makes the pickup tickets the **best method** to get **pre-war money** for the challenges. The "Collision Course" event at Morgantown Airport still provides 100 pre-war money upon completion, but the event only starts at intervals and if no one activates at that time, it will simply disappear again. Playing the event consciously, e.g. for the pre-war money challenges, is now almost impossible. In contrast, Bellhop is always available after the quest and a few tickets can be redeemed very quickly.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-pleasant-valley-tickets-03.jpg)
